definitions.explanation: A lattice or row of iron bars fixed across a window, cell or opening to keep people from getting in or out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鉄格子|てつごうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧はまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are iron bars on the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄格子|てつごうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一夜|いちや}→一夜：08961_ichiya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: The suspect spent the night behind bars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{洋館|ようかん}→洋館：30736_youkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地下室|ちかしつ}→地下室：12047_chikashitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{錆|さ}びた→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧{鉄格子|てつごうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: In the basement of the old Western-style house, a rusty iron-barred door remained.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄格子|てつごうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧: a barred window
- {鉄格子|てつごうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: behind bars (in prison or a cell)
- {鉄格子|てつごうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はめる: to fit bars (over a window)

USAGE:
{鉄格子|てつごうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ is the usual figurative way to say someone is in prison, much like English "behind bars". The plain ⟦{格子|こうし}→格子：32059_koushi⟧ is a lattice of any material, such as the wooden lattice on a traditional townhouse.
